name: session-skills
description: Seven skills for working inside one conversation. braindump plays back a pasted brain dump in very simple words and waits for your yes before any work starts. explain-simply says the last answer again as plain bullets without losing a number. grill-me interviews you one question at a time and writes every answer down. handoff saves what a long session learned and writes a prompt a fresh session can start from. session-summary tables what you asked for and where each request stands. track-tasks keeps every still-open topic on the built-in task list. spec-check reads the specification an agent is about to build from, flags anything that could skew the work, and proposes fixes before building starts. None of them writes to the project except where you approve it, and all seven install together.
